findings.issue: A fully returned COD order gets the remainder of grandTotal, including shipping and the COD fee. A prepaid return still refunds only unitPrice x qty clamped to the captured amount, so prepaid shoppers never get shipping back (confirmed). This is a policy asymmetry that the owner's option A approval may not have explicitly covered.
findings.fix: Confirm with the owner that refunding shipping and the COD fee on full COD returns is intended, or align the COD and prepaid refund rules in a follow-up.

findings.issue: processCodReceived reads earlier wallet credits (walletEntry.findMany) and then calls wallet.earn in a separate transaction. Two different returns of the same COD order marked received concurrently could both read the same alreadyCredited and together exceed grandTotal (likely; requires concurrent admin actions).
findings.fix: Do the cap read and the wallet credit in one prisma.$transaction, or lock the order row (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) before computing the credit.
